cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: reliable
cards.example: “She is one of the most reliable people on our team.”
cards.translation: 她是我们团队中最可靠的人之一。

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: take your time
cards.example: “Take your time — there’s no need to rush.”
cards.note: A gentle way to reassure someone

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: perspective
cards.example: “Travel can give you a fresh perspective on life.”
cards.translation: 旅行可以让你对生活有全新的看法。

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: make it count
cards.meaning: 让它变得有意义；好好利用
cards.example: “We only have one day here, so let’s make it count.”
cards.translation: 我们只有一天时间，所以好好利用它吧。

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: adapt
cards.example: “You need to adapt quickly when things change.”
cards.translation: 当事情发生变化时，你需要快速适应。
cards.note: Common at work and in life

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: as far as I know
cards.example: “As far as I know, the meeting starts at ten.”
cards.translation: 据我所知，会议十点开始。
cards.note: A useful way to soften a statement

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: encourage
cards.example: “Good teachers encourage students to ask questions.”
cards.translation: 好老师会鼓励学生提问。

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: it turns out
cards.example: “It turns out that we went to the same school.”
cards.translation: 原来我们上的是同一所学校。
cards.note: Use it when revealing a result

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: flexible
cards.translation: 我这周的时间安排很灵活。

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: on the bright side
cards.example: “On the bright side, we learned something new.”
cards.translation: 往好的方面看，我们学到了新东西。
cards.note: A way to find the positive

cards.label: Vocabulary
cards.title: benefit
cards.example: “One benefit of reading is a bigger vocabulary.”
cards.translation: 阅读的一个好处是能扩大词汇量。

cards.label: Short phrase
cards.title: that makes sense
cards.example: “That makes sense — thanks for explaining it.”
cards.translation: 这就说得通了——谢谢你的解释。
cards.note: A natural way to show understanding
